item.title: Needed 1+1, Built a Functional Programming Language
item.description: graphLang I was given a data structures problem of converting an arithmetic expression into a binary tree. Naturally, I decided to build an evaluator for it. A few days later I implemented closures, a garbage collector, a custom memory allocator, a REPL, an FFI, and a whole bunch of other stuff in C. THE DATA STRUCTURES ASSIGNMENT The problem was: Evaluate 1 + 1 + 1 to 3 using a binary tree.
